description: This PHP source file defines the class LegacyMPDFEngine, a PDF generation engine that extends the PDFEngine class. It utilizes the mPDF library to generate PDFs, providing methods for writing HTML content, adding CSS, outputting PDFs, and configuring PDF options. The file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically within its PDF handling module, and references external files such as mPDF library and configuration mappings.

classes.name: LegacyMPDFEngine
classes.description: A PDF engine class using mPDF for rendering PDFs within SuiteCRM, providing methods for HTML writing, CSS styling, and PDF configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mPDF object, optionally accepting an existing mPDF instance.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Writes HTML content into the PDF, allowing section-specific styling such as headers.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to a specified destination with a given filename.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTML header content for the PDF pages.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Sets the HTML footer content for the PDF pages.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Adds CSS styles to the PDF by embedding them into the document.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Adds a blank page to the PDF document.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Configures PDF settings based on external configuration mapping.
